RESIDENTIAL LEASE AGREEMENT

This Lease Agreement ("Agreement") is entered into between Landlord and Tenant.

1. TERM. The lease term shall commence on the Effective Date and continue for twelve (12)
months, automatically renewing on a month-to-month basis thereafter unless either party provides
thirty (30) days' written notice of termination.

2. RENT. Tenant shall pay monthly rent of $1,500, due on the first day of each month. A late fee
of $75 shall be assessed for any payment received after the 5th day of the month.

3. SECURITY DEPOSIT. Tenant shall deposit $1,500 as security for damages beyond normal wear and
tear. Landlord shall return the deposit, less any lawful deductions, within twenty-one (21) days
of move-out.

4. MAINTENANCE. Tenant is responsible for minor repairs under $100. Landlord is responsible for
major structural and system repairs. Tenant shall notify Landlord in writing of any needed
repairs within a reasonable time.

5. TERMINATION. Landlord may terminate this Agreement for non-payment of rent, material breach of
this Agreement, or illegal activity on the premises, subject to applicable state notice
requirements.

6. INDEMNIFICATION. Tenant agrees to indemnify and hold Landlord harmless from any claims arising
from Tenant's use of the premises, except for claims arising from Landlord's gross negligence.

7. GOVERNING LAW. This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of the state in which the premises
are located.
